source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Fuel - Fuel Pump, p.6M-16

procedures.title: Fuel pump: install
steps: Fit the pump with a new gasket, sealer on the mounting bolt threads, and tighten securely; on V8s hold the push rod up with mechanical fingers or heavy grease while fitting the pump (see figure 2P in the manual).
Start the engine and check for leaks.
